meta_description:
bruisedpassports on October 23, 2025: "It’s been a journey but the BEST is yet to come 🥂✈️
Bruised Passports App is now available to download on App Store and Play Store! 🎉 It has 15 years of our travel experience in 1 place - Use the scratch maps, track the countries you’ve visited, research for upcoming trips, plan your trips and keep a lookout for the launch of our favourite features on it in the coming weeks ✈️🌍".
